# Chowringhee Arts

> Export house in Kolkata, India, making handmade homeware for trade buyers: buffalo horn serveware and cutlery, bone inlay boxes and trays, mother-of-pearl dishes, trays and caviar spoons, seashell table pieces, and resin and terrazzo tableware. Trade only. Prices are quoted ex-works Kolkata, in US dollars, for the pieces a buyer asks about; there is no public price list and no full catalogue is sent.

Facts, as stated on the website:

- Who we sell to: importers, wholesalers, retail chains, hotel suppliers and buying agents. We do not sell to consumers.
- In business for 10 years. Proprietor: Siddhant Chandan. Office: 75C Park Street, Kolkata 700016, West Bengal, India.
- Member of EPCH, the Export Promotion Council for Handicrafts (registration no. 44785). IEC and GSTIN on request.
- Range: more than 4,000 designs: bowls, trays, dishes, boxes, cutlery and serveware, table accessories, desk pieces, combs and small furniture.
- Every piece is made by hand by karigars (skilled artisans); women are a big part of the team. No two pieces are exactly alike.
- The horn is real buffalo horn, never faux. Horn and bone are by-products of livestock farming; no animal is harmed for our products.
- Prices: ex-works Kolkata, in US dollars. Better prices from 100 pieces and again from 300 pieces per design.
- Payment: 50% advance with the order, balance before dispatch.
- Lead time: orders are ready 30 to 45 days after the advance.
- Samples: made on request, charged at the piece price.
- Custom work: sizes, colours and finishes to the buyer's specification.
- Exhibitor at IHGF Delhi Fair: Autumn 2025 (Hall 16, J-01/11), Spring 2026 (Hall 11, G10/29), Autumn 2026 (Hall 3, Stand E-06/05). Next: Spring 2027, 15 to 19 March 2027, India Expo Centre and Mart, Greater Noida (stand booked).
- How to enquire: tell us the pieces you are interested in (photos from the site, your own references or a description), the quantity per design, your company, country and market. We reply with photos, sizes and ex-works prices for those pieces.
- Contact: info@chowringheearts.com, WhatsApp or phone +91 98309 22999. We reply within 24 hours, 7 days a week.

- [Bone inlay](https://chowringheearts.com/bone-inlay/): boxes and trays in floral, geometric and striped patterns; how bone inlay is made; buyer FAQ
- [Mother-of-pearl](https://chowringheearts.com/mother-of-pearl/): carved dishes, trays, caviar spoons, serving spoons, salt and pepper sets; buyer FAQ
- [Seashell](https://chowringheearts.com/seashell/): shell spoons, napkin rings, salt and pepper sets, magnifying glasses and desk pieces; buyer FAQ
- [Resin and terrazzo](https://chowringheearts.com/resin/): boxes and tableware in coloured resin and terrazzo, some combined with bone; buyer FAQ

- [About us](https://chowringheearts.com/about/): the company, the karigars, the materials and fair history
